name: Editorial UI
desc: You, cut out onto a solid colour set on the hook and every punchline, with a huge serif headline behind your head. The set colour changes on each beat, cream UI cards (a prompt that types, a checklist, a magazine cover, a countdown) land on their words, and it cuts back to your real room in between. Premium and fast.
needs: A cut-out of you (BiRefNet, a few extra minutes on the set frames). Works best with a locked-off camera and some headroom above your head.
inspired_by: justyn.ai editorial reels (inspiration only, rebuilt from scratch in your brand colours)
